cohortDescription: Individuals with a non-missing bone-metastasis date falling within -90 to +30 days of the metastasis date. Cohort start is the bone-metastasis date; cohort end is taken from the metastasis cohort record.

Individuals with a zoledronic acid (ZA) and/or denosumab and/or alendronate (AA) start. Cohort start is the earliest of the ZA/denosumab/AA start dates (same-day ties ZA > denosumab > AA); cohort end is taken from the metastasis cohort record.

Individuals with no ZA and no denosumab start, who received at least one of ADT, ARPI, or chemotherapy. Cohort start is the earliest of the ADT/ARPI/chemo start dates (same-day ties ADT > ARPI > chemo); cohort end is taken from the metastasis cohort record.

Individuals from the bone-metastasis index with no BPA of any kind initiated on/after bone_date - 30 (no ZA, denosumab, AA, or other-BPA), who received at least one systemic treatment. Index is the earliest of the ADT/ARPI/chemo start dates (same-day ties ADT > ARPI > chemo); cohort end is taken from the metastasis cohort record.
Individuals in the BPA population whose first bone-targeting agent is denosumab. Cohort start is the denosumab start date; cohort end is taken from the metastasis cohort record.
Individuals in the BPA population whose first bone-targeting agent is ZA. Cohort start is the ZA start date; cohort end is taken from the metastasis cohort record.
Individuals in the BPA population whose first bone-targeting agent is AA. Cohort start is the AA start date; cohort end is taken from the metastasis cohort record.
Individuals in the BPA population whose first bone-targeting agent is not denosumab, not ZA and not AA. Cohort start is the BPA start date; cohort end is taken from the metastasis cohort record.
